new_string: Persistent state and settings updates SHALL use byte-level compare-and-swap against the expected prior bytes; a conflict SHALL retain the newer on-disk value. On partial startup, failed write, or service recovery, the launcher SHALL retain or restore the last known valid state and settings before resuming permitted hook work. Every non-SessionStart managed hook SHALL use the builtins-only hook-service client rather than a bare native HTTP URL. The client SHALL call the existing single-flight `ensureUp` lifecycle before dispatch, preserve the exact stdin request, authenticate with the current persisted credential, and proxy the hook response unchanged. If dispatch throws a connection-class transport error (`ECONNREFUSED`, socket reset, or connect timeout), it SHALL run `ensureUp` again and retry the exact request once. It SHALL not retry or restart for a live 401, 403, 404, or 503 response; it SHALL never kill an ownership-unverified process or foreign listener. A second transport failure SHALL remain fail-open and append a sanitized client diagnostic without exposing credentials. Recovery from an owned daemon death or stale registry/runtime digest SHALL complete inside the same Claude Code session without a user restart or manual bootstrap command.
